content.short: MemeFi is a popular Telegram-based tap-to-earn battle game featuring clan combat and on-chain rewards for players.
content.description: MemeFi is a viral Web3-native gaming ecosystem that blends meme culture with interactive social-tech mechanics. Originally launched on Linea, the project transitioned its core token operations to the Sui network to leverage high-speed transactions and low fees for its massive user base. Players engage in "tap-to-earn" gameplay, joining clans to battle epic bosses and other participants while earning on-chain rewards and exclusive digital assets. Designed for massive social engagement, MemeFi utilizes Telegram as its primary portal, allowing users to interact with decentralized economies easily.
content.meta: MemeFi is a gamified social-tech battle ecosystem on Sui and Linea featuring tap-to-earn rewards. Discover MemeFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
